title: add-invocation-telemetry-deduper-and-token-collapse-visualizer
author: Aisha Rahman
description: Introduce a lightweight Telemetry Deduper service and a Token Collapse Visualizer dashboard to reduce noisy duplicate spans and surface redundant token-level cost patterns. Motivation: during several incidents and routine SLO tuning we observed high cardinality and alert fatigue caused by duplicated spans emitted from the serving runtime (frontend retries, duplicate instrumentation points, and batched replays). This PR implements a deterministic fingerprinting pipeline that collapses semantically-identical spans early in the observability ingestion path and a dashboard that helps engineers understand when token costs are dominated by collapsed/duplicate traffic. The change includes a TTL-backed fingerprint cache, session-aware collapse heuristics, an orthogonal latency decomposition helper ("orthogonalizer") that attributes latency to queue/io/model phases for collapsed invocations, alert tuning rules to avoid duplicate alert storms, end-to-end tests with synthetic replay, and a Grafana dashboard with an interactive token-collapse Sankey and cost-savings calculator. Backwards compatibility: original spans are still retained in sampled snapshots; deduped counts are emitted as both raw_count and deduped_count so downstream consumers can opt-in. This description includes: design rationale, implementation summary, QA notes, rollout plan, and linked Linear/Jira items.

review_comments: Ben Carter: Nice design; double-check that fingerprinting is stable across SDK versions. If the SDK changes field ordering we might get different fingerprints. Can we canonicalize JSON fields before hashing?
Aisha Rahman: Good point — we canonicalize by using a deterministic field ordering and a trimmed key set (service, span_name, callsite_id, token_span_hash). Added unit to test canonicalization.
Lara Kim: Question on retention: you collapse early — where do engineers look when they need raw traces? Are we losing fidelity?

Aisha Rahman: We emit sampled raw spans at a configurable sample rate and keep a 'recent_raw_snapshot' buffer for 1 hour. Deduped_count is emitted as a metric and the raw sample includes an "original_spans" array when sampled. Documented in ops runbook.
Mateo Alvarez: The orthogonalizer code looks promising but the math should be commented — hard to review. Add a short note explaining the decomposition and assumptions.
Aisha Rahman: Added docstring and a design paragraph in docs/observability/README.md; moved linear algebra helpers to a util module and included a reproducible example.
CI Bot: Unit tests failed on first run (integration e2e timeout).
Aisha Rahman: Increased timeout for synthetic replay and added retry backoff; re-ran CI, tests passed.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash merge. Merge commit message: 'Add telemetry deduper, orthogonalizer, token-collapse-visualizer dashboards, and alert tuning (ENG-1429, SUP-518)'. Rollout: phased in canary (10% tenants) for 48h then global. Ops ticket created for rollback knob.
release_notes: Adds a telemetry deduplication stage to the ingest pipeline that reduces duplicate spans and lowers alert noise; introduces a Token Collapse Visualizer dashboard to inspect redundant token-level cost and a latency orthogonalizer to attribute latency by phase. Default behavior preserves sampled raw spans. See docs/observability/README.md for rollout and tuning.
notes_for_onsite_sre: Canary deploy under flags: deduper.enabled=true and deduper.canary_tenants=[internal-*]. If alerts spike after canary, set deduper.mode=passthrough to disable collapse and keep metrics intact. Runbook: ops/monitoring/runbooks/token-collapse-runbook.md
